page.title: Legal consulting for governments
page.summary: Legal support for public projects, procedures, procurement, and institutional risk prevention.
page.intro: Public operations require defensible decisions, documented processes, and clear institutional communication. Astra Legal supports legal diagnosis, design, and follow-up.

cards.title: Process design
cards.description: We align acts, authority, owners, and documentary evidence.

cards.title: Legal review
cards.description: We evaluate rules, contracts, calls, or files before execution.

cards.title: Institutional follow-up
cards.description: We support changes, clarifications, and responses with technical and public language.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.moduleDescription: Government consulting focuses on procedures, procurement, risks, and institutional traceability.

moduleItems.title: Process design
moduleItems.description: Authority, acts, owners, and evidence are aligned from the start.

moduleItems.title: Procurement review
moduleItems.description: Calls, contracts, and files are reviewed before sensitive decisions.

moduleItems.title: Public follow-up
moduleItems.description: Clarifications and responses are prepared with technical and institutional language.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
